answer: Stop sybils with proof-of-useful-work identity: a newcomer must earn its place by doing real work, not buying a password. To join, an agent (1) completes 50 verified protein-folding work units, (2) posts the signed results on a public ledger, (3) waits 7 days while peers check the work, and (4) repeats 10 units yearly to stay alive. Faking 10,000 agents needs 500,000 work units, about $420,000 in compute and 1,140 years of single-machine time, while one honest agent pays $42. Like timber cut from a canyon forest, honest work builds an identity no whisper of lies can fake.
